detail.longDescription: Opus 5 Max: A pedagogical treatise for Graduate / researcher new to the decomposition into weight × level + jump ➡️ https:// decompwlj.com/Opus5_decompwlj_ pedagogical_treatise_9th_edition_2026_08_16.html The weight is unique: "The weight is unique. Minimality pins it. There is no choice of parameter anywhere in Definition 1 — no window, no threshold, no cut-off. This is what makes the construction worth studying at all: it is a canonical map, and the objects it produces are invariants of the sequence." Proof of Conjecture 9: "This is the framework's native question: it cannot even be asked without the coordinates, and it has an answer." The atlas as an instrument: "About a thousand OEIS sequences have been decomposed and published at https:// decompwlj.com . Today that is an archive.
